x: The Southern Junior team will be weakened because Herbert and Boyden will be too old, but fortunately Edwards and Bradnum come in here. Lomas, Marchant and Scarfe represented us in the Surrey Youths' race and finished in position 21, 22 and 23.
Bradnum, who unfortunately had to drop out, they showed good packing and team work, as can be seen by glancing at their finishing positions.
Abberton (B), 42.48; 18, Bradnum (B), 42.51; 20, Stimpson (B), 42.59; 21, Laing (B), 43.6; 24, Gray (B), 45.28; 26, Badger (B), 45.44; Saville (B), 45.59.
